basis: Cutaneous fibrosis defines NSF; fascial and periarticular fibrosis causes contractures in >30%. Renal impairment precedes NSF.
LOXHD1-related nonsyndromic sensorineural hearing loss; bilateral impairment in 7/7 patients.
Congenital unilateral absence of the lower leg and foot is a structural limb disorder.
Organic acid metabolism disorder; neurodevelopmental injury affects roughly half and intrinsic chronic kidney injury about 30-60%, varying by subtype.
Disease of the submandibular salivary gland; salivary glands belong to the gastrointestinal axis.
Defined by thyroid C-cell neoplasia and other endocrine tumours. Catecholamine symptoms do not establish direct extra-endocrine organ damage.
Inherited abnormality of sebaceous glands, which are skin appendages.
Adult-onset lysosomal storage disease with neurodegeneration; damaging retinal involvement is not established as common in this adult subtype.
Viral infection umbrella; respiratory and intestinal localization varies across the included viral groups.
Corneal ulceration with perforation directly damages the eye; an infectious or autoimmune cause is not specified.
Hereditary cancer of the prostate, a reproductive organ outside the axes; metastatic sites are not defining.
Gonococcal infection establishes the infection axis; the affected endometrium is outside the anatomical axes.
Congenital structural malformation of pulmonary airways and lung tissue.
Adrenal aldosterone synthesis deficiency causes salt wasting and electrolyte abnormalities; these do not establish intrinsic renal injury.
Ectopic tubal-type epithelium confined to the uterus; reproductive tissue has no axis.
Pigment dilution, immunodeficiency and hemophagocytic cytopenias define GS2; hepatic infiltration/hepatomegaly 80-99%, jaundice 30-79%; neurologic injury <30%.
Abnormal secretion of the hormone gastrin; gastrointestinal injury is not established across this umbrella.
Encephalopathy, growth hormone deficiency and retinal degeneration are defining features; craniosynostosis frequency is unspecified.
Defined by inflammatory granulomatous arteritis and juvenile polyarthritis, affecting vessels and joints.
Behavioral excessive drinking without physiological stimulus; no intrinsic organ damage defines the umbrella. Electrolyte complications are not universal.
Obstetric abnormality of amniotic fluid volume; fetal renal or pulmonary disorders are not intrinsic across this concept.
Hereditary ferritin/hepcidin dysregulation concerns iron metabolism; no evidence of blood-cell disease or damaging tissue iron overload.
ACTG1-related nonsyndromic progressive sensorineural hearing loss.
Aneurysms and early osteoarthritis define disease; abnormal skin scarring occurs in 30-79%. Dural ectasia (~61%) does not itself establish neural injury.
Hip dislocation and joint laxity define syndrome; septal/valvular defects and hearing abnormalities each occur in 30-79%; urinary abnormalities 5-29%.
